summary: Abivax S.A. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a public offering of up to $600,000,000 in American Depositary Shares, each representing one ordinary share. The offering is underwritten by Leerink Partners, Morgan Stanley, Piper Sandler, Guggenheim Securities, LifeSci Capital, and Van Lanschot Kempen. The filing is a standard equity shelf takedown by a well-known seasoned issuer, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The offering is subject to market conditions and regulatory approvals.
